header.running_head: 2. Doing Deeds for the Pleasure of Allah...

blocks.tamil_translation: heard this and remained silent; after a little while the following ayah was revealed (فَمَنْ كَانَ يَرْجُوْ لِقَاءَ رَبِّهِ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلاً صَالِحًا وَلَا يُشْرِكْ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِ اَحَدًا) “Whoever hopes to meet his Lord, (wishes to become His beloved), let him keep doing good deeds, and let him not associate anyone as a partner in the worship of his Rabb.”

blocks.text:
Explanation:- The Shirk forbidden in this ayah is showing off. Moreover, even if a deed is for Allah Ta'ala, if some desire of the self is mixed in with it, that too is a kind of hidden Shirk! This too wastes a person's deed.
(Tafsir Ibn Kathir
2. Doing Deeds for the Pleasure of Allah with Full Iman and Certainty of Reward

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: اَرْبَعُوْنَ خَصْلَةً اَعْلَاهُنَّ مَنِيْحَةُ الْعَنْزِ، مَا مِنْ عَامِلٍ يَعْمَلُ بِخَصْلَةٍ مِنْهَا رَجَاءَ ثَوَابِهَا وَتَصْدِيْقَ مَوْعِدِهَا اِلَّا اَدْخَلَهُ اللهُ بِهَا الْجَنَّةَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، باب فضل المنيحة، رقم:٢٦٣١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said, “There are forty good qualities; the highest in rank among them is that a person gives his goat to another, and the one who received it benefits from its milk and then returns it to its owner. Whoever does a deed of any one of these works with the hope of receiving the reward promised by Allah Ta'ala, because of that hope Allah Ta'ala will admit him into Jannah.”

blocks.text: Explanation:- The Prophet ﷺ not describing the forty good
